title: Perforated strip with a counted row of holes

description.en: A flat strip 120 x 20 x 3 mm (corner at the origin, along +X, +Y, +Z) with a row of 5 mm holes along its centre line at a 10 mm pitch: as many holes as fit with every hole centre at least 7.5 mm from the ends, and the row centred on the strip. The number of holes must follow the length: drive the strip by the variables length, width, thickness, hole_d, pitch and margin.
description.nl: Een vlakke strip van 120 x 20 x 3 mm (hoek in de oorsprong, langs +X, +Y, +Z) met een rij gaten van 5 mm op de middellijn met een steek van 10 mm: zoveel gaten als er passen met elk gatmidden minstens 7,5 mm van de uiteinden, en de rij in het midden van de strip. Het aantal gaten moet de lengte volgen: stuur de strip met de variabelen length, width, thickness, hole_d, pitch en margin.

variables.name: margin
variables.meaning: least distance from a hole centre to an end

variables.name: n
variables.meaning: the number of holes (derived; the candidate need not name it)

expect.value: 2 * (length * width - n * pi / 4 * hole_d^2) + 2 * (length + width) * thickness + n * pi * hole_d * thickness

derivation: Holes fit while (n - 1) p <= L - 2 m, so n = floor((L - 2 m) / p) + 1 = floor(10.5) + 1 = 11; centred, the first is at (L - (n - 1) p) / 2 = 10 mm.
V = (L W - n pi d^2 / 4) t = (2400 - 11 * 19.635) * 3 = 6552.0 mm^3; area as for any plate with n round through holes.
A centred row keeps the centroid at the strip's centre. Faces: 6 of the strip and one wall per hole.
The variants change the length so that n changes: 150 mm gives 14 holes, 133 mm gives 12.
